name: Balanta-Kentohe
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Wilson, W. A. A. 1961. Outline of the Balanta Language (African Language Studies); also Doneux 1984 Eléments de grammaire balante and Quintino 1951. None accessible online.

sources.citation: Creissels, Denis. 2024. A sketch of Ganja (Balant) [author preprint of the Oxford Guide to the Atlantic Languages chapter], 47 pp.
sources.note: Balanta-GANJA (bala1302), not Kentohe. p.3: 'the main sources on Kentohe grammar and lexicon are Wilson (1961), Doneux (1984a), and Doneux (1984b)'. Phonology (2.1-2.5) covers consonants, vowels, tone, syllable, liaison; 'stress'/'accent' occur zero times.

sources.citation: Creissels, Denis & Séckou Biaye. 2016. Le balant ganja: phonologie, morphosyntaxe, liste lexicale, textes. Dakar: IFAN. 370 pp.
sources.note: Ganja only. Intro pp.7-9 read: Doneux 1984a describes Kentohe; Fudeman 1999 and Gomes 2008 are judged unreliable (semi-speaker idiolect; tones ignored). Ch. 2 has tone (2.3) but no stress/accent section; 'accent' only as orthographic accent aigu/circonflexe.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record bala1301 (JSON); Glottolog MEDs: Doneux 1984 grammar_sketch (107 pp.), Quintino 1951 (52 pp.), de Sousa Bella 1946 (35 pp.), Bernatzik 1933 wordlist
sources.note: Bibliographic only; confirms that the descriptive literature is Doneux 1984, Quintino 1951/1961, de Sousa Bella 1946, Wilson 1961 (target file), none with URLs.

sources.citation: Namone, Dabana. 2020. Educação tradicional e moderna na Guiné-Bissau e o impacto da língua portuguesa no ensino: caso das crianças da etnia Balanta-Nhacra de Tombali. PhD, UNESP.
sources.note: Education thesis; 594 'balanta' hits but no phonology, accent or tone content.

Phoneme tables only (sourced to Creissels & Biaye 2016 and Mbodj 2011); nothing on stress or tone. The fr bibliography supplied the Mbodj 2011 URL and the exact BCGP volume/number/pages for Quintino 1951 and de Sousa Bella 1946.
